scope.discovery_ledgers: all available Glob discovery ledgers through sequence 30
scope.raw_hit_reservoirs: all available raw-hit reservoirs through append 22
scope.principle: Retroactively evaluate everything covered so far for any concrete Worldshepherd use; preserve original Glob evidence classes and do not reinterpret usefulness as evidence.

coverage_policy.utility_axis: A substantive item can be useful for science, engineering, software, security, manufacturing, operations, governance, commercialization, partner intelligence, data, AI/ML, testing, supply chain or negative-control work.
coverage_policy.evidence_axis: Glob evidence remains separately classified P2/P1/G1/M1/N0/gated with theory/evaluated/compiled/experimental subtypes where applicable.
coverage_policy.historical_integrity: Do not rewrite prior evidence outcomes merely to broaden utility routing. Add cross-domain uses as a retrospective overlay with provenance to the original source/ledger.
coverage_policy.retention: Retain substantive discoveries even when the matched number is only an identifier, page, address, accession, software code, grant, CVE, catalog number, or other control occurrence.

retrospective_crosswalk.group: Atomic, molecular and spectroscopy authorities/data infrastructure
retrospective_crosswalk.why: Machine-readable schemas, uncertainty models, state identifiers, line-list conversion, evaluated-data workflows and cross-database reconciliation are reusable software/data/validation capabilities beyond spectroscopy itself.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: No added utility changes any P1/P2/M1/N0 status.

covered_items: LHD diagnostic catalog and retrieval manual
IAEA tungsten CRP and technical meetings
retrospective_crosswalk.why: These sources provide multichannel data ingestion patterns, diagnostic synchronization, model/measurement reconciliation, uncertainty targets, archived benchmark corpora and current research-network intelligence.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Fusion-data utility is independent of Glob-number hits.

retrospective_crosswalk.group: RF, EM, photonics and metasurface control
covered_items: programmable EM boundary-condition hardware project input
two-color HHG and attosecond quantum-path control
retrospective_crosswalk.why: Coupler calibration, VNA verification, assembly tolerance mitigation, conformal design, field-control methods and detector architectures are directly reusable in hardware build/test/control workflows.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Bibliographic identifiers remain controls unless independently physical.

retrospective_crosswalk.why: These sources inform timestamped raw/derived sensor separation, calibration, nuisance rejection, fusion architecture, imaging pipelines and sensor-data integrity.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Sensor-system usefulness is orthogonal to number-match evidence.

retrospective_crosswalk.why: The accumulated corpus covers processing routes, defect engineering, characterization stacks, scale-up constraints, critical-material substitution, durability and commercial-production implications.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Material usefulness does not validate unrelated Glob physical hypotheses.

retrospective_crosswalk.group: Software, algorithms, data engineering and model governance
retrospective_crosswalk.why: These items collectively support ingestion, validation, optimization, resource allocation, model comparison, reproducible computation and digital-manufacturing automation.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Algorithmic utility does not imply physical causality for number relations.

retrospective_crosswalk.why: Time-source compromise, dependency drift, build/runtime privilege separation and advisory ingestion directly affect trusted provenance, audit chronology and production readiness.

retrospective_crosswalk.group: Operations research, reliability, civil/environmental systems and metrology
retrospective_crosswalk.why: These provide scheduling, calibration, nondestructive evaluation, stress-response, environmental-process and multiphysics solver benchmarks.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Article IDs/pages/postal codes remain raw controls.

retrospective_crosswalk.group: Commercialization, finance, standards, IP and opportunity intelligence
covered_items: ACS Petroleum Research Fund identifier/source context
patent publications surfaced by raw matches
retrospective_crosswalk.why: Standards, funding mechanisms, institutional networks, patent signals and research-program structures affect capture strategy, partnership, capital planning, sourcing and evidence-generation pathways.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Commercial utility does not confer Glob evidence.

retrospective_crosswalk.why: The growing raw reservoir supports empirical collision-rate estimation, namespace-specific null models, query-bias measurement, duplicate control and future automated classifiers for admissible vs non-admissible evidence.
retrospective_crosswalk.evidence_boundary: Control frequency must never be counted as positive physical evidence.

coverage_requirements_from_now_on: Every new substantive source receives at least one explicit Worldshepherd utility destination or an explicit negative-control-only justification.
Every prior source group remains eligible for additional utility routing as new modules/use cases are created.
Utility routing must not overwrite historical P2/P1/G1/M1/N0 classifications.
Raw-number reservoir entries remain retained even when their source has no immediate use beyond collision/null statistics.
Periodic audits must check for under-routed software, security, manufacturing, operations, business, supply-chain and partner-intelligence value, not just scientific value.
audit_status: RETROACTIVE_COVERAGE_BASELINE_ESTABLISHED; source-by-source fine-grained backfill remains open and should continue alongside internet scanning.
